findings: formation.text: “Indicative” is a sound classification, but the explanation says the three strokes directly represent the quantity three. Classify the formation as pictographic if treating the strokes as a numeral sign, or clarify the indicator convention being shown; the current account does not distinguish an indicator mark from direct numerical representation. E2, E4, and X-cf2e4185c438e7569f0f describe three strokes representing three, while E1 and E4 call the graph ideographic/indicative.
